exact_defect.before: When exact prior_outputs and completed prior receipts were supplied, a changed predicate_ref_by_query was ignored and cached units were skipped.
exact_defect.after: Before cache reuse, every QUERY unit's supplied predicate must be present in that unit's exact semantic_input_refs; otherwise SavedC11AdmissionError('SAVED_BATCH_PREDICATE_BINDING_MISMATCH').
